Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Body re-take (one cloud seat per PR), PR #2566, branch fix/r10-handover-refresh, head cc4e944b14b88330a7f29d3bc981f254986ed383, topic r10-handover-refresh. If a red is this PR's OWN failure (e.g. closures on #2558 because the diff changed a closure-relevant file), fix it in code on handoff/r10-handover-refresh with a failing-first proof per dev/governance/roles/fixer.md (PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 locally; derive closures only in CI) and say so in the body. (3) Re-take every figure the body states that your change moves; keep ## Head naming the head you leave. (4) Verify the body with bash tools/pr/prepr.sh offline arms you can run (policy_lint --pr-body, carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body F). Push code only if you changed code (to handoff/r10-handover-refresh, merged from origin/main, never rebased) and the body with bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-handover-refresh <body.md>; the handoff-body push is your return signal.
